profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Procore Technologies
profile.summary: Hello! I'm Juyoung Kim, a new grad software engineer. I graduated from Vanderbilt with a double major in Computer Science and Mathematics and a minor in Engineering Management.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: -Worked with Instagram Web team to migrate Instagram pages to a new backend, increasing efficiency for pages used by millions of users

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
– TA for CS 2212: Discrete Structures (Spring 2020 - Present) and CS 1151: Computer Ethics (Fall 2019)
– Discussed discrete and data structure concepts with students in weekly office hours for a core computer science class with 200+ students
– Graded assignments/quizzes and revised homework keys

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
– Undergraduate Research Assistant for the MEDLab at Vanderbilt University
- Robert F. Wagner All-Conference Best Student Paper Award Finalist at SPIE Medical Imaging 2021
– Created live-tracking for Da Vinci surgical robot probes by using Python and C++ with 3DSlicer and Plus Toolkit
– Conducting research on image registration and guidance for minimally invasive surgery, submitted to SPIE Medical Imaging
– Researched with lab in Summer 2019 and Summer 2020

positions.title: Hackathon Organizer
positions.description:
– Dev (2020-present), Logistics (2020), and Hacker Experience (2019) board member
– Streamlined and added dark mode to Vaken, our hackathon management system architecture that was used by over 750 applicants, with Typescript
– Created learn.vandyhacks.org to highlight VandyHacks workshops
– Brokered connections with five nonprofits to create project and externship opportunities for hackers

positions.title: Change++ Executive Board Member
positions.description:
– Executive board (2020-present), project manager (2019-2020) and developer (2018-2019) for Change++, a student-run organization creating applications for nonprofits
- Managed 6 teams of project managers and developers to deliver apps and websites to various nonprofits and organizations
– Created an AWS RDS database for Peabody Coalition of Black Graduates at Vanderbilt University
– Full stack development with mySQL, node.js, HTML/CSS under an Agile framework
– Deployed with Heroku at https://immense-harbor-88562.herokuapp.com

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
– Created a health dashboard and backend API to monitor critical information about Capital One’s internal financial APIs,
reducing microservice deployment times by 20%
– Full stack development with React, Go, and AWS Lambdas

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Software Development Intern on the MAS Data Architecture team
- Integrated Jenkins CI/CD pipelines into Docker container construction
– Created and automated framework for analyzing Airflow data integrity with PyTest, reduced deployment time by 40%

honors.title: Robert F. Wagner All-Conference Best Student Paper Award Finalist
honors.description: - Best student paper finalist for paper "Integrating Firefly fluorescence into image guidance for the da Vinci robot"
honors.issuer: Issued by SPIE Medical Imaging 2021 · Feb 2021

honors.title: Cornelius Vanderbilt Scholar
honors.description:
- 4-year, full tuition merit scholarship from Vanderbilt University
- Given to < 1% of applicants

publications.title: Integrating FireFly fluorescence into image guidance for the da Vinci robot
publications.publisher: SPIE Proceedings Vol. 11598: Medical Imaging 2021: Image-Guided Procedures, Robotic Interventions, and Modeling · Feb 15, 2021
